data.title: Bank asks for ID copy and self-disclosure form
data.summary: Muster Bank AG asks David Muster to send a copy of a valid ID and the completed self-disclosure form under the Money Laundering Act (Geldwäschegesetz). The documents are due within 8 working days of the letter date, 18 December 2025.
data.explanation: Your bank must keep your customer data up to date by law. It needs a copy of your valid ID and the completed self-disclosure form (Selbstauskunftsbogen). Send them by the deadline shown. Working days here are Monday to Saturday, excluding public holidays. If you don't, the bank says it will block your securities account (Depot) for purchases until the matter is cleared. Check that the request is genuine by contacting the bank through its known contact details before sending your ID.
